issues.description: The UML in the problem statement specifies getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() should return a double (to allow fractional students per tutor), but the solution implementation defines getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() with an int return type. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and will cause failing expectations if tests (or the specification) expect a double.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the UML/specification by changing the method signature in the Lecture class to return double and compute using floating-point division, e.g. public double getNumberOfStudentsPerTutor() { return (double) getTotalNumberOfStudents() / getNumberOfTutors(); }. Alternatively, if integer division was intended, update the UML and problem statement to indicate an int return type.
